audit.whatIsWrong: Two fields call his damage block a 'passive shield' and claim it stops autos but never your boomerang.
audit.why: Mortal Will is the passive — it empowers his next spell every few casts or attacks; it is not a shield. The block is Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18s, 400 range), a channel that makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT. Riot's text draws no distinction between autos and projectiles, so the claim that it never stops Avengerang is unsupported.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault blocks frontal damage on a 22-second channel — poke from an angle or wait it out; Mortal Will is the empower, not a shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes describe his early cheese and late fall-off with no cooldowns.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9s and Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8s — so his level 1-2 kill pattern is on a 13-second timer, and stepping up right after a spent W is safe. Grand Starfall is 180/165/150s with 5500 range, so he can arrive in another lane long before it is up again.
audit.corrected: Step up on Shield Vault's 13-second downtime; Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1 and reaches 5500 range, so it is a map threat, not a lane one.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault's auto-attack reset is never mentioned.
audit.why: Shield Vault is an auto-reset dash-stun, so the burst lands on the attack wind-up rather than the visible cast — the cue to disengage is his step-up animation. Aegis Assault also makes him untargetable-grade safe from the front for the whole channel, so a Comeuppance fired into it is spent for nothing.
audit.corrected: Shield Vault resets his attack — read the wind-up, not the cast; never fire Comeuppance into an Aegis Assault facing you.

edits.before: E (Heroic Swing) comes online and your range turns on — swing off terrain to fire Avengerang from outside his W gap-close while his passive can block your autos but never your boomerang.
edits.after: Heroic Swing comes online and your range turns on — swing off terrain to fire Avengerang from outside Shield Vault's 600 reach, and never shoot into an Aegis Assault pointed at you.

edits.before: Hold his passive shield toward you to block your double-shot autos and trade up in the melee range he forces
edits.after: Turn Aegis Assault toward you to eat your shots from the front and trade up in the melee range he forces

edits.before: Land the W stun to lock you out of Heroic Swing and burst you while you can't kite or swing away
edits.after: Land Shield Vault's stun — it resets his attack, so the burst lands on the wind-up, not the cast

edits.before: Heroic Swing comes online at 3 and your Q range lets you swing off terrain and poke from outside his W gap-close for free.
edits.after: Heroic Swing comes online at 3 and your Q range lets you poke from outside Shield Vault's 600 reach, angling around Aegis Assault.

edits.before: Pantheon's first two levels are the only scary part: his W dashes onto you and stuns, then a held empowered Q (Comet Spear) hits hard — so do NOT walk up to last-hit inside his W gap-close range before you have E. At level 1 you only have Q and one passive shot, so concede the level, farm at max Avengerang range, and never get caught flat-footed for the W-stun-into-Q. The instant you hit 3 and unlock Heroic Swing the lane flips: he can angle his passive shield to block your autos but never your boomerang, and once you can swing off terrain he can't trade into your range.
edits.after: Pantheon's first two levels are the only scary part: Shield Vault (13s at rank 1) dashes onto you and stuns, and because it resets his attack the burst lands on the wind-up — so do NOT walk up to last-hit inside 600 range before you have E. At level 1 you only have Q and one passive shot, so concede the level and farm at max Avengerang range. The instant you hit 3 and unlock Heroic Swing the lane flips: he can face Aegis Assault at you to eat damage from the front, but once you swing off terrain he can't trade into your range.

notes: Mortal Will was being used as the name of a shield; the block is Aegis Assault (E, 22s), and Riot's text says it blocks damage from the front without exempting projectiles — I removed the unsupported 'never your boomerang' claim rather than reversing it, since the kit cannot settle whether Avengerang is blocked. UNVERIFIED: spikes[3], late and whys[6] all state Comeuppance deals 'up to 200% bonus on missing HP'. That figure is not in the kit file and I left those strings untouched.
